description: This file defines an authentication store using Zustand, managing user session state including login, registration, bootstrap (session restoration), and logout functions, with interactions to external API services.

methods.name: bootstrap
methods.description: Restores user session data from local storage or fetches current user info from API.

methods.name: login
methods.description: Performs login via API, updates store and local storage.

methods.name: register
methods.description: Performs registration via API, updates store and local storage.

methods.name: logout
methods.description: Performs logout via API, clears local storage and resets store.
